items.source: This annotation may be used as a meta-annotation to create custom composed annotations. Consult the source code for @Commit for a concrete example.
items.translation: 此注解可用作元注解来创建自定义的组合注解。请查看源代码中@Commit的具体示例。

items.source: Warning: Declaring @Commit and @Rollback on the same test method or on the same test class is unsupported and may lead to unpredictable results.
items.translation: 警告：在同一测试方法或同一测试类中声明@Commit和@Rollback不受支持，并可能导致不可预测的结果。

items.source: When declared as a class-level annotation, @Rollback defines the default rollback semantics for all test methods within the test class hierarchy or nested class hierarchy. When declared as a method-level annotation, @Rollback defines rollback semantics for the specific test method, potentially overriding class-level default commit or rollback semantics.
items.translation: 当声明为类级别注解时，`@Rollback` 定义了测试类层次结构或嵌套类层次结构中所有测试方法的默认回滚语义。当声明为方法级别注解时，`@Rollback` 定义特定测试方法的回滚语义，可能会覆盖类级别的默认提交或回滚语义。

items.source: @Commit can be used as direct replacement for @Rollback(false).
If true, the transaction will be rolled back; otherwise, the transaction will be committed.
items.translation: 如果为true，则回滚事务；否则，提交事务。

items.source: Consult the class-level Javadoc for TransactionalTestExecutionListener for an explanation of test-managed transactions.
items.translation: Consult the class-level Javadoc for TransactionalTestExecutionListener 以了解测试管理的交易的解释。

items.source: This annotation will be inherited from an enclosing test class by default. See @NestedTestConfiguration for details.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此注解将从外部测试类继承。有关详细信息，请参阅 @NestedTestConfiguration。

items.source: Whether the test-managed transaction should be rolled back after the test method has completed.
items.translation: 测试方法完成后，是否应回滚测试管理的交易。
